reasons.persona_fit: Directly addresses the owner-operator in Bareni's calm, practical voice with no hype, no invented team or customer claims, and respects the no-CTA rule.
reasons.clarity: The main point is immediately clear, logically separating messy folder symptoms from identifying a single recurring document lookup.
reasons.actionability: Provides a realistic, concrete manual logging exercise over one week to decide whether a document workflow actually warrants automation.
reasons.factual_grounding: Makes no fabricated customer, capability, or result claims, keeping automation conditional on finding a recurring workflow.
